summary: Process-lifetime coordination owns the session catalog synchronizer, Ghostty surface reconciliation and focus observation loops. TerminalSessionsModel keeps an app-side projection of authoritative daemon sessions/workspaces plus local selection, focus and layout edits; selected session and user preferences use UserDefaults. Axod remains the source of truth for live process/session state. The sidebar keeps local collapsed-workspace and rename-draft presentation state, with selection and session/workspace operations delegated to TerminalSessionsModel.
lifetime: Coordination lasts for app process lifetime; UI model state is reconstructed from daemon snapshots and events on connection/reconnection. A small set of presentation preferences persists in UserDefaults.
